services.name: Helicopter Specs
services.desc: You’ll whet your appetite for adventure while flying around the four scenic lakes created by dams on the 200-mile-long Salt River, including Saguaro, Canyon, Apache, and Roosevelt Lakes. Fed by high-altitude springs and streams 100 miles to the northeast. The Salt River flows down from the mountains and through Phoenix before it joins the Gila River. Along the way, sightings of hidden coves, desert mountains, bald eagles and wild horses abound. There are as many as 500 of these magnificent animals roaming the water’s edge on the lower Salt River and the shoreline around Saguaro Lake.
